Restore password recovery
Restore passkey recovery

For a screen-lock backup, use the lock from the device that made it. For a Google Password Manager PIN backup, use that PIN. Enter it only on this protected screen. Each attempt is checked with Google and can count toward the backup’s limit.

Use the PIN, password or pattern you entered to try restoring this selected backup for this account? An incorrect attempt can reduce the backup’s remaining attempts. A request whose result is uncertain will not be repeated automatically.
Finish recovery
Verify and save the keys recovered by the saved attempt? Your PIN, password or pattern will not be submitted again.
Close this attempt without repeating it? A request Google already received may have counted toward the limit. Its protected receipt remains saved; another attempt needs a new confirmation.
The backup was opened. Finish recovery to verify and save its keys for this account.
